descriptions.w3d_f13c_encyclopedia_update_8027fca8: Reads Ped.Current, refreshes its bounds, sets previous/next availability, resolves DATA.Wormopaedia, copies the selected entry title into a native retained string, translates title and description when property lookup succeeds, and publishes title, description, image and movie properties with movie availability based on the file string. Preserves early-return held-interface cleanup and every shared-string retain/release; entry/list layouts and encyclopedia roles are inferred.
